status.summary: Unbeaten welterweight (pro 19-0, UFC 7-0) who has not fought since his unanimous decision over Ian Machado Garry at UFC 310 (Dec 7, 2024). A knee injury has needed several surgeries, most recently reported for Jan 31, 2026 with a 9-10 month recovery estimate. He was back in contact training by late May 2026, his physician said in July there was no medical bar to returning in early 2027, and his coach Eduard Bazrov named February 2027. On Oct 30, 2026 his manager, Daniel Rubenstein, denied a rumored January 2027 fight with Jack Della Maddalena. No bout is booked.

style.summary: A tall, long-armed orthodox finisher who pressures behind a jab, front and body kicks, then wins the clinch and scrambles to take the back or snap a guillotine. Five of seven UFC wins are submissions and one is a head-kick KO. His one decision, over Machado Garry, came from control time. He is unbeaten but has not fought since December 2024.

moves.notes: Weights follow his target split in fighters.json. Decayed significant attempts go 78.7% head, 18.8% body, 2.5% legs; landed strikes go 71.4% head, 24.7% body, 3.9% legs. Career body landed is 26%, well above the welterweight league attempt share of 13.9%, so body kicks and straights get heavy weight, and calf and inside kicks almost none. About 24% of decayed landed strikes come in the clinch, so knees get 0.25. The 0.05 spinning weight covers the wheel kick that finished Carlston Harris (ufcstats records it as 'Kick to Head At Distance, Wheel kick'). The split between front kicks and round kicks to the body is not in the data. The sample is small: 75 UFC minutes, and 113 of his 244 career significant landed strikes (46%) came in one fight (Neal). Sources: ufcstats sums and per-fight totals.
